abilities.descEn:
Rangers will have a high chance of being revived when they are defeated.
Rangers will be revived with 70% HP. This Ability will only activate once.
abilities.descZh:
Ranger被打倒時將能以高機率復活。
能力發動後將以70%體力的狀態復活，且無法再次發動該能力。

abilities.descEn:
Rangers with this Ability won't be affected by change effects.
Size change effects cannot be prevented.
abilities.descZh:
持有這個能力的Ranger不會受到變身效果影響。
無法抵擋尺寸變更的變身效果。

abilities.descEn: Gives a high chance of increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed. This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
abilities.descZh: 出動擁有此能力的Ranger時，能以高機率增加敵方隊伍1隻Ranger的生產礦物成本。此能力可於戰鬥開始10秒後發動。

abilities.descEn: Gives a high chance that 1 Ranger on the opposite team will have the time until it can be redeployed frozen for a fixed amount of time when a Ranger with this Ability is deployed. Activates 10 seconds after the battle starts.
abilities.descZh: 出動擁有此能力的Ranger時，能以高機率將敵方隊伍1隻Ranger的重新產生時間量表凍結一定時間。此能力可於戰鬥開始10秒後發動。
